title: H3 storyboard contract
description: Storyboard data contract: one storyboard.json describes a short film's character/scene asset references and ordered shots, compiled deterministically by scripts/compile_storyboard.py into MiniMax H3 prompts (Ref2VA six-section / FL2VA three-section). Every value is English, including human-readable management fields (title, cut_reason, continuity_risk). This schema constrains structure only; semantic required fields (world_pos, axis_en, positions.*.facing|view_target, lighting_en, camera_move(_en), first_frame_hard, etc.) are enforced by the compiler gate; see references/storyboard-contract.md §5.

title.description: English human-readable title; not injected into prompts.

art_style_prefix.description: Frozen English style sentence. Placed at the start of every generated segment for cross-segment style consistency.

video.description: Generation defaults for the execution layer (ComfyUI / Hub runner); the compiler only reads default_max_duration.

default_max_duration.description: Physical duration cap per segment in seconds. Longer shots are auto-split into subsegments that repeat the same prompt (auto_split_repeats_action warn). Sibling subsegments from one shot are not duplicate_action errors.

characters.description: Named label '@CharacterName' → character definition. The key is the reference label compiled to <Subject N> / <Picture N>.

scenes.description: Named label '#SceneName' → scene definition. Scenes also occupy a <Subject N> (for example a white background <Subject 3>).

shots.description: Ordered shots; order is the generation segment order. First segment is Ref2VA when refs are present, otherwise T2VA; later segments are FL2VA.

name_en.description: English noun phrase used as the subject of '<Subject N> is …', e.g. 'the school-age girl'.

ref_front.description: Reference image path (Phase 1 inline real path, e.g. img/1_girl.png; Phase 2 resolved from assets/manifest.json). Duty: identity.

asset.description: Phase 2 asset directory (four-view reference board), e.g. assets/char/CHAR_001/.

static_features.description: Persistent English features (face shape, hairstyle, skin tone, eyes, build) used in <Subject N> definitions and blocking sections.

dynamic_features.description: Changeable English features (wardrobe, accessories, carried items).

do_not_change.description: English fidelity constraints (hairstyle, outfit colours, body proportions); used for retention_analysis when retention_en is absent.

ref_role.description: Duty of this reference (identity / composition / action / voice). One image cannot be both identity and first frame.

retention_en.description: Optional English line for retention_analysis; defaults to do_not_change joined together.

ref_wide.description: Scene wide plate path without characters. May be null in Phase 1. Duty: space.

static_features.description: English phrases describing the fixed space.

shared_by.description: Character labels present in this scene, used to generate 'shared by <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>'.

slugline.description: INT./EXT. plus time of day, e.g. 'EXT. SCHOOL GATE - DUSK'.

anchors.description: English stable landmarks/exits with a role, e.g. 'door frame = the only entrance at the right edge'.

scene_space.description: English scene-space map for systematic world positions.

shot_size_en.description: English shot size, e.g. 'a locked-off full-body shot'.

camera_move.description: Camera-move enum (static / pan_left / truck_right / push_in / pull_out / arc / tracking / tilt_up …) used for soft repetition checks.

camera_move_en.description: Full English camera sentence with start, end/target, follow target, and stopping reason. Static shots still need a complete sentence.

refs.description: Self-contained reference bindings: label → image path. No 'same as above'. Ref2VA segments require this; FL2VA segments use an empty object.

ref_binding.description: Per-shot registry (path → {duty, version}). Optional in Phase 1; generated by RefMapBuilder.

world_pos.description: English world positions relative to named landmarks; stable across camera changes.

axis_en.description: English 180-degree axis description: whose line, which side the camera is on, whether this shot crosses it.

positions.description: Screen positions for this camera setup. Key order determines <Subject N> order.

screen_pos.description: English screen position, e.g. 'left of the frame'.

facing.description: English body facing, e.g. 'toward the camera'.

lighting_en.description: Explicit English lighting baseline, rebuilt with blocking and injected into the prompt.

beats.description: Timed beats ('start-end s') covering the full duration. action feeds detailed_description; sound feeds overall_soundscape.

action.description: English visible action in this beat.

camera.description: English camera move for this beat.

handoff.description: English movement state handed to the next segment (motion only, not a blocking source).

source.description: Fidelity annotation: original = stated in source; added = performance/staging detail only; tbd = human confirmation required.

first_frame_hard.description: English opening state. Ref2VA: opening frame; FL2VA: previous segment's closing frame expanded into a zero-pronoun physical description.

last_frame_hard.description: English closing state handed to the next segment.

overall_soundscape.description: English ambient/action/non-verbal sound summary; defaults to aggregated beats[].sound.

non_diegetic_music.description: English standalone music section, or exactly 'N/A'.

preserve_avoid.description: Optional English retain/avoid sentence; defaults to compiler text: reference sheets never appear in output + no subtitles/logos.

shot_purpose.description: English shot purpose; also the Ref2VA summary sentence.

allow_repeat.description: Explicitly allow this shot to repeat another shot's visible action (e.g. a designed loop). Sibling subsegments from one auto-split shot are exempt.

fidelity_lock.description: Fidelity lock: write only source actions; no AI-invented plot.
